name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S309 shipped the Director's Report and the repairer for a failure class the repo could detect but never cure. /news/directors-report/ has ORSON ranking all seven writers in public, explaining his assignments and taking the blame where it is his; deriveDeskPerformance() computes assignments/words/panels/leads/graded-calls FROM the corpus so only the judgement is authored. It shipped live with the GENERIC share card — the generator hardcoded it, the build-og-cards auto-promoter skips news pages because the Desk emits no og:title, and the live probe checked status and HTML rather than the card; now fixed at the generator and verified 200 on production with a bespoke card. resync-derived.mjs rebuilds the transitive closure of the evidence graph in topological order after a rebase, because a conflict list shows COLLISIONS not DEPENDENTS: regenerating the two feeds named in this rebase's conflict list got the push rejected twice more by artifacts that never conflicted, and a replay flags 10 of 17 dirty. Its first run invoked deploy-staging.mjs attempting a real deploy to repair a rebase, stopped only by an unrelated failing check — sideEffecting is now declared in the graph with a mutation-tested structural guard.
publicNote: The Desk now has a Director. ORSON assigns the stories, then publishes a public review ranking every writer — including what each of them owes the reader next, and where he got the assignment wrong himself.
nextMilestone: Get VERA, JUNO and NIB actually writing — ORSON has committed to it on a live public page, and three of seven writers have filed nothing. Then reconcile the evidence graph against every --check'd artifact with a structural gate, since resync-derived covers 17 nodes while the repo byte-checks more and stays silent on the rest.
